source_population: 2025-01-02 reconstructed A-share member intervals; 128 issuer deterministic identity-only sample
financial_source: Eastmoney 2024 FY report RPT_LICO_FN_CPD; current 2026 vendor vintage; required source-row SHA matches archived 2026-10-31 128 financial coverage
eligible_only: price comparison eligible true, no shifts of entry or exit dates
selection_count: ceil(number of eligible candidates in exact entry session / 3); stable security_id ascending tie-break

feature_spec.revenue_growth_yoy_pct: YSTZ as recorded by 2026 vintage financial vendor, not 2025 source-certified
feature_spec.weighted_roe_pct: WEIGHTAVG_ROE as recorded by 2026 vintage vendor, not original-time PIT certified

primary_rule: Rank highest 2024 annual revenue growth YoY and ROE within exact first trade session, combine two rank positions using equal weights, select best one-third of groups with >=5 eligible issuers
primary_metric: equal_weighted selected stocks 2025 price_only_return minus 0.003 cost minus same-stock same-window CSI300 price index return

same_day_random_baseline.metric: realized_net_return = stock 20-session unadjusted price-only return minus 0.003; not total return
same_day_random_baseline.sampling: select same number of names within each exact entry-session opportunity set, without replacement

selection_concentration: A few 2025 announcement episodes; no temporal OOS or independently untouched future outcomes
multiple_comparisons: 1 primary screen plus 2 predeclared diagnostics; no post-outcome retuning; any random tail rates are exploratory diagnostics, not valid statistical p-values
coverage_policy: Preserve 128 fixed rows; 8 already marked ST/nontradeable are never assigned a numeric outcome. Smaller entry cohorts remain in denominator and are not selected. Do not fill or reweight failed/missing issuers as if they achieved random baseline returns.
forbidden: Change frozen research thresholds or past outcomes
Describe hindsight vendor FY2024 metrics as contemporaneous PIT
Turn exploratory 2025 exercise into strategy admission or live BUY
